answer: The grove schedule is applied in quill and raven shows each instalment. An copycat thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3635 identities would post 716 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
